notes.title: Hidden Cats: Old Amusement - Released!
notes.notes: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3908190/Hidden_Cats_Old_Amusement_Park/?curator_clanid=45457146"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The continuation of the Hidden Cats: Old amusement park game series is released. Explore mysterious abandoned amusement park, finding cute cats and paint black - white locations with colored paints. Interesting, attention-grabbing picture, 101 cute cats and pleasant atmospheric music are waiting for you.[/p]
